# Industrial Heat Pump (IndustrialHeatPump)

> **Class**: `IndustrialHeatPump` | **Module**: `energysim.models.hvac_thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Industrial Heat Pump with temperature-lift dependent COP.

COP = carnot_efficiency * T_sink / (T_sink - T_source) in Kelvin, with the
lift floored at 5 K and COP clamped to [1.2, 7.0]. The COP is evaluated
continuously from the current source/sink temperatures (also when idle).
Capacity is not derated with temperature and there is no start-up dynamic.

Validity: source -10..60 C, sink 30..120 C, lift 10..90 K.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'HeatPump'` | - | - |
| `q_max_thermal_mw` | `float` | `10.0` | MW | Maximum thermal heating capacity in MW. |
| `carnot_efficiency` | `float` | `0.5` | - | Empirical factor of theoretical Carnot efficiency. |
| `t_source_nom_c` | `float` | `15.0` | degC | Nominal source temperature in C (e.g. ambient air, river, waste water). |
| `t_sink_nom_c` | `float` | `75.0` | degC | Nominal sink delivery temperature in C (district heat or process water). |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import IndustrialHeatPump

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('industrialheatpump', model=IndustrialHeatPump(), outputs=['P_elec_MW', 'Q_heat_MW', 'COP'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['industrialheatpump'].tail(2))
```
